Preventive measures for hair fall (in short):

Balanced diet – Eat protein-rich foods (eggs, pulses, nuts) and ensure iron, zinc, and vitamins.

Avoid tight hairstyles – Tight ponytails/braids can cause traction hair loss.

Gentle hair care – Avoid excessive heat, harsh chemicals, and frequent styling.

Manage stress – Stress can trigger hair shedding.

Regular scalp hygiene – Wash scalp regularly to prevent dandruff and infections.

Adequate sleep & hydration – Helps maintain hair growth cycle.

Correct nutritional deficiencies – Especially vitamin D, B12, iron if low.

Early treatment of scalp disorders – e.g., dandruff, fungal infections.

If hair fall persists, evaluate for conditions like Telogen Effluvium, Androgenetic Alopecia, or Alopecia Areata.
